Each probe R_p acts as a constraint on this space, ensuring that only validated configurations proceed. Failure in any R_p triggers a retrograde state, preventing erroneous inference. This architecture mirrors a Bayesian network where prior knowledge (keys) informs posterior decisions (fallbacks), with probe outcomes serving as evidence updates.
